message: Dependabot reads its configuration only from the repository root, on the default branch, so it does not read web/.github/dependabot.yml in the project web, and the repository root has no Dependabot configuration
fix: Move web/.github/dependabot.yml to the .github directory at the repository root, with directory: /web in its updates entries, then run depcurfew apply

message: Renovate reads its configuration only from the repository root, on the default branch, so it does not read web/renovate.json in the project web, and the repository root has no Renovate configuration
fix: Move web/renovate.json to the repository root, then run depcurfew apply
